title: PLASMID FALSIFICATION — Could the triad be US?
the_question: The triad traffic comes from DE, JP, IN. We own vesicles in DE, JP, IN. Are we looking at our own reflection?

rate_match.plausible_cron: while true; do curl -s primals.eco > /dev/null; sleep 100; done

lockstep.observation: all 3 hit at exactly the same rate simultaneously
lockstep.explanation_if_ours: same script deployed to all 3 vesicles. identical config.

ssh_locked.observation: we can't SSH in to check what's running
ssh_locked.explanation: key mismatch means these were set up with a key we lost or rotated. we literally don't know what's on them.
ssh_locked.weight: MEDIUM — absence of evidence is not evidence of absence

caddy_running.observation: Caddy is active on 3 of 4 vesicles (not golgi-us)
caddy_running.explanation: Caddy was deployed. SOMETHING was configured. If a health check was part of the setup script...

null_user_agent.problem: curl sends 'curl/x.y.z' by default. wget sends 'Wget/x.y.z'. null UA requires explicit '-A ""' flag or a raw socket.
null_user_agent.weight: MEDIUM — could be 'curl -A "" -s' in the script

rate_not_cron.observation: 36/hr is not a standard cron interval
rate_not_cron.problem: cron's minimum is 1/min = 60/hr. 36/hr = every 100 seconds. you'd need a sleep loop, not cron.
rate_not_cron.counter: a systemd timer or a bash loop is totally plausible. Kevin writes sleep loops.

lockstep_broke.observation: the lockstep BROKE at 14:00 UTC Oct 23
lockstep_broke.problem_if_ours: why would our own vesicles desync? nobody SSHed in (keys don't work). the scripts didn't change.
lockstep_broke.possible_explanation: server reboot, OOM kill, disk full, provider maintenance. any of these would desync a sleep loop.
lockstep_broke.weight: MEDIUM — breaking lockstep is harder to explain if it's our own identical scripts

DE_exploring_independently.observation: after lockstep broke, DE hit 545/hr in one hour. that's not a 'sleep 100' loop.
DE_exploring_independently.problem_if_ours: our vesicle can't change its own behavior. something ELSE is also hitting from DE.
DE_exploring_independently.possible_explanation: the 545/hr is a DIFFERENT DE source overlapping with our vesicle's base rate.
DE_exploring_independently.weight: HIGH — this is the strongest counter-evidence

BE_and_NL.observation: BE and NL appeared with DIFFERENT signatures. we have no vesicles there.
BE_and_NL.weight: N/A — this is about new actors, not the triad

FR_manual_browse.observation: 281 requests at 9AM Paris time from OVH France IP
FR_manual_browse.our_OVH_is_US: our OVH box (golgi-us) is 40.160.96.29 in the US, not France
FR_manual_browse.weight: HIGH — 141.94.194.132 is NOT our IP. we don't have a France VPS.

verdict.honest_assessment: We genuinely cannot tell. The geographic match is suspicious (3/3 exact countries). The rate match is plausible (sleep 100). But the lockstep breaking and DE's 545/hr spike argue against pure self-traffic. MOST LIKELY: a MIX. Our vesicles generate the 36/hr baseline. External actors generate the bursts and spikes on top.
verdict.the_embarrassing_possibility: Kevin may have deployed a health check script to the vesicles months ago, forgotten about it, lost the SSH key, and then we spent 4 days analyzing our own health checks as if they were external probes. The mirror was reflecting our own face.
verdict.the_important_distinction: Even if the 36/hr BASELINE is us, the CHANGES are real: lockstep breaking, DE exploring at 545/hr, FR at the beacon, BE/NL surging. Those are NOT us. The external signal is ON TOP of whatever our vesicles generate.

resolution_path.definitive_test: SSH into the vesicles. Check crontab. Check running processes. Check bash_history.
resolution_path.blocked_by: SSH key mismatch. Need console access from Hetzner/Vultr/Linode to reset the key.
resolution_path.kevin_action: Log into Hetzner, Vultr, Linode web consoles. Add chipMONK SSH key. Then we can check.
resolution_path.alternative_test: Add a CF firewall rule to BLOCK requests from 2.28.141.35, 202.182.107.135, 172.232.85.202. If the triad baseline drops to zero ? it was us. If it stays ? it's external.
resolution_path.non_destructive_test: Add a CF Worker that logs the source IP for DE/JP/IN requests. If the IPs match our vesicles ? confirmed self. If different IPs ? confirmed external.

if_self.R1_through_R4: the probe was us probing ourselves. the spirochete model is still valid but the 'they' is 'we'. the mirror was reflecting Kevin's own forgotten infrastructure.
if_self.R5_R6: the CHANGES are still real. external actors appeared. the dissolution of lockstep likely = our vesicle rebooted + external traffic mixed in.
if_self.papers: all the analysis papers are still valid as methodology. the subject changes from 'external probe' to 'self-probe plus external noise'.

if_external.everything_stands: the analysis was correct. monitoring service + human explorers.
if_external.but_we_should_still_check: because leaving 3 forgotten VPSes running unknown scripts is a security issue regardless.
